computer-assisted proof of optimality posted by Ethan Hendren: a minimum-enclosing-triangle normalization to eight contact families, an exact cell-graph search and exactly checked LP certificates, with a certified local basin, show the value 43/784 with the known configuration unique up to symmetry; AI-assisted and not yet independently verified

optimality proof completed with a replayable certificate trace (Ethan Hendren): every split and closure of the exact search, 3,854 shards and 69,194,387 closures, is replayed in exact arithmetic by a separate checker that does not use the search code; the trace, checker and strict eight-family release receipt are archived on Zenodo; AI-assisted, and so far replayed only by its author
